title: paulwhoisaclippy
lines: This desktop is your game world.
spoken: Hi, I'm Paul who is a Clippy.
Welcome to wtfOS. This desktop is your game world. I'll be around to help.

title: Click an icon.
spoken: The icons on your desktop open programs.

title: Find the rest.
lines: Open it to find more apps.
spoken: Open Stuffs on the taskbar to find the rest of your apps.

title: Keep your place.
spoken: You can move or minimize windows.
Find them again on the taskbar whenever you're ready.

title: Mission Control.
lines: Some missions can earn XP, too.
spoken: Mission Control shows challenges, progress, and rewards.
Some missions can earn XP or rewards.

title: Pick a direction.
spoken: Try Arcade for games, or Create for making things.
Events and Talk are here when you want people.

title: Start anywhere.
spoken: You don't need to learn it all now. Pick one thing.
I'll be haunting your desktop, in a helpful way.
